Grounding obligation description: Messages posted in #eng-updates, #product-launch, or #incident-response that received a reaction from a user who holds a conversation membership in the channel named 'security'. Used to report the determined set of matching messages.
Shared scope: Candidate pool is every message authored in channels C_ENG, C_PROD, C_INC, each carrying zero or more reactions; the actor has membership access to all five relevant channels.
